title: No test checks that taking back free AI credits never takes credits the gym paid for
what: The take-back test starts from a gym that holds only free credits, so it proves the balance never goes below zero but never tries a gym that also bought a pack. Bought credits being taken back or expired is never tried either.
expected: A test gives a gym a bought pack and some free credits, takes back more than the free part, and checks the bought credits stay; and checks a month change never expires bought credits.
fix_line: Add a database check with bought and free credits mixed, then a take-back and a month change.

title: The nightly run is never tested with its backup or its first clean-up failing
what: The 03:00 test lets every step succeed. Nothing checks that the clean-up still runs when the backup fails, or that the gym server clean-up still runs when the Cloudflare clean-up fails. The log lines of the night are silenced in every test.
expected: Two tests: a failed backup night still runs every clean-up; a failed Cloudflare clean-up still runs the gym server one and reports failed; the logged words are checked.
fix_line: Add two night tests where an early step fails, and check the later steps still ran.

title: Signing out of HQ and the 30-day sign-in end are never tested
what: The HQ door tests cover signing in and refusals by status code only. No test signs out (Google or Cloudflare Access mode), checks the old session stops working, lets a session pass 30 days, or checks the words on the refused, server-down and not-set-up pages, or that the log says whether a sign-in was fresh.
expected: Tests sign out and then retry the old cookie, move the clock past 30 days, check each refusal page's words, and check the sign-in log row carries the fresh flag.
fix_line: Add sign-out, 30-day expiry and refusal-page word checks to the HQ door tests.

title: No test checks a fee pop-up skips members not on the app, members who left, or another gym
what: The fee note test uses list members of one gym who are linked to the app. Nothing tries a list member with no app account, a member who left the gym, or an id from a second gym, so a please-pay pop-up reaching the wrong person or a gym they left is never ruled out, and the desk is never checked for telling staff the member was notified.
expected: The database test adds an unlinked member, a member who left, and a second gym, and checks no note is made for any of them.
fix_line: Add unlinked, left and other-gym members to the fee note database test.

title: The backup's real part size and its public status door are only half tested
what: The split test cuts copies into 40-byte parts, so the real part size is never checked against the store's 25 MiB limit, and the parts count in the meta is never read. No test tries a POST or other call to the public backup status to show it cannot change anything or read a copy.
expected: A test checks the real part size stays under the limit and the meta names the parts; another tries a POST and other paths under the backup door and gets sign-in or a refusal.
fix_line: Check the real part size and meta, and try a write call on the public backup status.
